reuse_permission: Public licence or specific written permission and any sharing restrictions
material_system: Binary or clearly identified two-phase material
composition_and_units: e.g. atomic fraction or weight percent, with source
ageing_temperature_and_units: Temperature for every stage, e.g. 773 K
imaging_modality: SEM, TEM, APT reconstruction, X-ray CT, etc.
phase_definition_and_evidence: Which measured feature is the foreground phase and how this was verified
specimen_or_sampling_design: Registered same specimen/volume, or independent specimens at each stage; list counts
instrument_and_reconstruction_changes: Changes to settings, detector, contrast, reconstruction or resolution at each stage
roi_rule_and_expert: Predeclared specimen-interior region rule and person who can review it
segmentation_candidates_and_rationale: Several technically plausible thresholds or expert masks, declared before fitting
